summary: PO margin 6.8% is below the 8% minimum threshold — PO issuance blocked
root_cause: During PI acceptance, the supplier negotiated freight cost revisions that reduced the PortLess margin from 9.2% to 6.8%. The PO margin guard blocked issuance. The agreed price of USD 1,398/MT needs to be renegotiated or the buyer price increased to restore minimum margin.

remediation_steps.description: Calculate minimum agreed price to achieve 8% margin at current buyer price USD 1,500
remediation_steps.result: Max agreed price for 8% margin: USD 1,380/MT

remediation_steps.description: Initiate renegotiation round with supplier to reduce agreed price to USD 1,380 or below
Alternatively, negotiate buyer price increase to USD 1,520+ to restore margin at current agreed price
Once margin restored, re-issue PI and proceed to PO issuance

resolution_note: Escalated to HITL approval APPR-MGN-20240130-007 for margin renegotiation decision.
